newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gold seen under pressure, $336 beckons.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gold seen under pressure, $336 beckons.

text.p: SPOT NY CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Gold bullion is likely to move towards expected support at $336.00 an ounce on Monday following Far East selling, traders and analysts said.
Silver was seen moving towards $4.70 and possibly lower after breaking below the 10- and 30-day moving averages at around $4.75.
Platinum and palladium should remain firm.
GOLD - Likely to find downside pressure towards four-year lows of around $336.00 following Far Eastern liquidation against a backdrop of downtrending charts.
Investment fund selling was likely to emerge if gold broke below first support at $337.00.
"A move below $337.00 is on the horizon...there is little to support the market," one trader said. A strong dollar was also helping to dent gold, traders said.
"Poor charts and a strong dollar is not what gold needs at the moment," the trader said.
He believed that a break below $336 would easily see the market head towards $330.00.
Martin Squires of Rudolf Wolff said, "The metal is looking increasingly vulnerable...we look for further weakness with a potential target of $310.00."
On the upside, previous support at $340.00 would offer resistance, followed by $342.50.
At 0700 GMT spot gold was indicated at $337.00/$337.50, versus Friday's London close of $338.20/$338.70.
SILVER - Seen lower with gold but expected to find some support at $4.70 after breaking below the 10- and 30-day moving averages at around $475.00 on Friday.
However, the market was expected to enter a period of consolidation as the technical indicators adopted a sideways trading pattern. Below $4.70 next support was pegged at $4.60..
Resistance was expected at $4.80.
At 0700 GMT spot silver was quoted at $4.72/4.74, against $4.74/$4.76.
PLATINUM/PALLADIUM - Likely to hold firm levels in the absence of platinum group metal shipments from Russia.
Platinum was expected to trade around $420.00, while palladium would attempt to consolidate above $200.00.
At 0700 GMT spot platinum was quoted at $421.00/426.00, compared with $423.00/$428.00. Palladium was at $203.00/$208.00, versus $194.00/$199.00.
